# Sloth Money

> Sloth Money helps couples build shared goals, budgets, and long-term money plans.

## Main pages

- [Sloth Money](https://slothmoney.app/): Product overview and permanent free-beta access.
- [Developer guide](https://slothmoney.app/developers/): Agent API authentication, CLI setup, account and investment views, current and historical budget activity, transaction filtering by opaque account reference, receipt extraction and confirmed receipt items, planned-budget updates, assigned-budget movements, transaction sharing and split changes, transaction notification rules and transient contract renewal-date extraction, server-backed goal previews, account-funded goal forecasts, goal priority ordering, transaction categorization, endpoints, and safe write workflows.
- [Privacy policy](https://slothmoney.app/privacy/): How Sloth Money handles personal and financial data.

## Developer resources

- [Sloth Agent CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@slothmoney/agent-cli): Public command-line client for inspecting and managing accounts, investments, budgets, goals, and reviewed receipt evidence; previewing account-funded goals with the canonical server planner; filtering transactions by opaque account reference; reading current and historical money-in, money-out, and net budget activity; updating planned amounts; moving assigned budget money; changing owned transaction sharing and splits; managing transaction notification rules and transient contract renewal-date extraction; updating goal priorities; and categorizing transactions through the Sloth Agent API.
- [Sloth Agent CLI source](https://github.com/RathBala/sloth-agent-cli): MIT-licensed source code and usage documentation.
